title.en: sshd: authentication attempts within the bound

description.en: MaxAuthTries as reported by sshd -T (the effective value, defaults included)

collectors.source:
#!/bin/bash
# observes sshd.maxauthtries from the effective sshd configuration
set -o pipefail
v=$(sshd -T | awk '$1=="maxauthtries"{print $2}') || exit 1
if [ -n "$v" ]; then printf '{"facts":{"sshd.maxauthtries":%s}}\n' "$v"; else echo '{"facts":{}}'; fi
